notes: Tenant broke the lease mid-term: vacated about 2023-03-13 (sheet), inspection 2023-03-14, lease ran to 2023-08-31. March rent (2695) was charged in full on 3/1 for 3/1-3/31; the tenant held possession through about 3/13, so the month straddles move-out. No future rent after March or reletting fee was charged. The first full month (Sept 2022) was prepaid by ePayment on 08/08/2022. Rent was paid late and in installments Oct 2022-Feb 2023 with late fees, all paid. The Move Out Form's '8/31/23' move-out date is the lease end, not the actual vacate date. The cleaning line combines deep clean and item removal without a split. The vendor did not complete downstairs painting ('prior to calling it off').
